name: Ogre Thieves
summary: In western Duskwood, Abercrombie sends travelers to the ogre stronghold at Vul'Gol Ogre Mound. He says the ogres ambushed him while he foraged and took a crate of irreplaceable herbs and tools.

sections.title: A Hermit's Lost Goods
sections.body: Abercrombie, an aged hermit on the damp roads of western Duskwood, says he was attacked while gathering supplies. Brutes from the southern ogre mound drove him off, and he left behind a sturdy wooden crate packed with precious herbs and delicate instruments.

sections.title: The Vul'Gol Threat
sections.body: The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in southern Duskwood, where hostile ogres harass unwary wanderers. Abercrombie's crate rests right near the entrance, among roaring brutes and spell-weaving magi.

sections.title: A Slip of the Tongue
sections.body: When Abercrombie gets his goods back, his eccentric manner gives way to manic excitement. He nearly shouts praise to 'the Nec—' before catching himself and thanking you instead. Then he eagerly shuts himself away to put his recovered supplies to use in the dark.

faq.answer: Abercrombie is an eccentric hermit in a worn shack in western Duskwood. He acts frail and helpless, and seems to need assistance, though his frantic behavior and strange requests hint at darker motives.

faq.q: Where did the ogres take Abercrombie's crate?
faq.answer: The ogres took Abercrombie's crate to Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood. It rests exposed on the dirt right outside the mound's entrance.

faq.q: Why are there ogres in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The ogres of the Vul'Gol clan carved out a foothold in Duskwood's rugged southern hills. Aggressive and opportunistic, they raid passersby, ambush solitary wanderers, and hoard stolen plunder around their mound.

faq.q: What is actually inside the crate?
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims the crate holds rare herbs and specialized harvesting tools he abandoned during the attack. He is overjoyed to have them back.

faq.q: What did Abercrombie almost say when receiving the crate?
faq.answer: As Abercrombie gets his crate back, he starts to thank someone else, then abruptly catches himself and thanks you instead. He gleefully looks forward to the nights ahead.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other tasks at the ogre mound?
faq.answer: Travelers headed to Vul'Gol Ogre Mound may also be gathering ogre monocles for Viktori Prism'Antras.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may recognize Abercrombie's slip of the tongue as praise for dark spellcraft, rather than simple love of plants.
As a paladin, you may take Abercrombie's eager, secretive delight at recovering his crate as a reason to be wary of helping the reclusive hermit blindly.
As an herbalist, you may wonder what bizarre flora could make Abercrombie so desperate to retrieve his crate from an ogre mound.
